scope: One necessary synthetic CPU check and metadata freeze/transport for the two fixed role conditions
No actual pretrained-model loading, original QA forward, generation, training, scoring or activation is authorized by this source review
static_findings: KeepGate replaces only up and KeepUp only gate. Both retain dense down and all other components. Square-root FP32 SVD factors are cast to FP16 and frozen; final state contains factor parameters instead of the replaced dense matrix.

Both initial compressed complete checkpoints derive from the same parent; restoring all original modules between decompositions is guarded by a full parent digest. q/v initialization and training RNG are reset identically, and the final verifier compares q/v initial digests.

The original stage-training AST prefix retains QA ordering, QA-normalized gradient accumulation, clipping, scaler and scheduler behavior, stage-local optimizer reset and validity checks. One Method instance preserves q/v weights across the 19 stages.

The two arms share HostAdamW and saved-tensor CPU offload. Durable per-update gradient and optimizer witnesses and per-stage adapter states are produced without introducing trainable compression factors.

Actual final attention folding removes the q/v adapters. Complete state, layout and digest are saved; training references are released; a new architecture with factor modules strictly reloads the final package before final generation.

The verifier requires exact phase file sets, all 19 validity/stage states and 87 gradient/optimizer records, matching STARTED/EXIT/COMPLETE identity and READY, one physical GPU, resource PID/terminal phase, checkpoint size/SHA and full 100-ID/all-reference coverage.
Original tokens/score AST is used once over exactly 500 new predictions after all phases complete. The old wide-q/v point is read from its fixed existing VERIFIED proof without rescoring.

The dispatcher ignores CPU_GATE_STARTED when checking model-attempt markers, requires a separately bound model-admission review, retains the first selected GPU, checks isolated own-child UID/startticks/PGID before reclamation, and polls against the remaining independent deadline.
The synthetic check includes actual q/v changes, frozen parameter invariance, folding and disk serialization followed by strict reconstruction/reload, within the existing four updates per arm.
resolved_blockers: The model-attempt wildcard previously matched CPU_GATE_STARTED; it now checks only the three model phases.
The synthetic reload now exercises torch.save/load and reconstruction rather than only deepcopy/load_state_dict.
The final verifier now rejects missing or extra mandatory phase files and checks identity/resources/checkpoint metadata.
Generation has an observation-only score guard rejecting NaN/+Inf/all-masked rows while preserving normal scores, with one check per generated token.
Resource sampling is stopped and joined before the final complete snapshot and file hashing; deadline sleep uses the remaining allowance.
limitations: Static acceptance is not a CPU_GATE pass or actual-model admission. No Torch/module execution, synthetic check, original QA, model, score or activation was performed by this reviewer.
The tiny gate is FP32 CPU only and cannot prove CUDA FP16 numerical behavior, actual large-model memory/time feasibility, or original Answer F1.

Counts 816728096 versus 893675552 remain design expectations until actual complete layouts and packages are verified. Retaining base assets for architecture construction is not evidence of reduced inference peak or latency.
Initial function damage is part of this role-allocation intervention. Initial/final differences do not isolate pure trainability, gate plasticity, PAS causality, or OSFT mechanism.

Previously explored 100 DEV and a single seed support only the fixed priority decision. Failure closes this point; success does not establish stable superiority, originality, a complete framework, or authorize further experiments.
Existing closed rank200/other workers and checkpoints remain closed. This is an independent one-branch contrast, not restoration of those runs.
required_next_step: Run only the single reviewed tiny CPU gate and metadata freeze on exact transported bytes; then obtain the separate actual-model admission review before any model STARTED.
